units.note: ξενικῆς παρασκευῆς (49.8) may mean a mercenary establishment rather than 'provisions from abroad'; the phrase is ambiguous, so I propose no fix.
καθ᾽ ὅσον … κατὰ τοσοῦτον is kept by 'by just so much'.
The Greek sentence τί δ᾽ ἂν κάλλιον | θέαμα τούτου φανείη runs across the 53/54 seam. The English completes it at the end of 53, correctly.
